request.description: FOUR independent rigid rings around a stationary sphere. The LARGEST OUTER RING does one complete VERTICAL SOMERSAULT about the horizontal left-to-right axis. Its top tips behind the sphere, bottom comes forward. Face-on at start, narrow horizontal ellipse at quarter turn, face-on reversed at half turn, narrow ellipse at three-quarter turn, original pose at full turn. Its inclination MUST visibly change; never a frozen circular frame. Correct depth: rear arcs hidden behind opaque globe, front arcs pass in front. Other rings continue independently: vertical hoop rotates vertically, horizontal hoop horizontally in opposite direction, diagonal hoop diagonally. Rings remain rigid and concentric with fixed radii. Constant angular speed, seamless loop, no rocking. Plain ivory globe stays fixed with identical engraving and shading: NO maps or continents. Fixed camera and scale, original monochrome pixel hatching on black.
